summary: @servicetitan/startup-jest preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package is advertised as a small Jest CLI wrapper but its package.json declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...`, unpacks it, chmods it executable, and then invokes the freshly-fetched Bun binary against a bundled `math_init.js` file via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line heavily obfuscated blob with a shuffled string array and a rotating decoder function (`WV8StW`), non-ASCII pseudo-random identifiers, and no readable purpose. A Jest wrapper does not need an alternate JavaScript runtime, and the runtime is used specifically to execute an obfuscated payload that ordinary Node-based scanners do not resolve. All of this fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
